content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSS Chemistry Krishna School of Science nurtures chemistry learners through rigorous academics, research orientation, and industry-linked opportunities. 0 Established 0 UG, PG & Ph.D. Tracks 0+ Major Scope Areas 0 Career Clusters LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSS Dr. Miral Vora Head of Department, Chemistry bos2.kss@kpgu.ac.in Dear learned visitor, it is with immense pride and pleasure that I welcome you to the Department of Chemistry at Krishna School of Science. Our department, established in 2020, serves students from both rural and urban backgrounds and focuses on developing skills relevant to growing chemical industries while nurturing future entrepreneurs, academicians, and researchers. At the core of our mission is a vibrant learning environment that encourages curiosity, critical thinking, and interdisciplinary collaboration. We integrate rigorous academic training with hands-on laboratory experience, research projects, and real-world problem-solving opportunities. The department actively engages in analytical chemistry, organic and inorganic synthesis, materials science, environmental chemistry, medicinal chemistry, green chemistry, petrochemical technology, industrial chemistry, and computational chemistry to contribute sustainable scientific solutions. We encourage participation in extracurricular activities, outreach, and professional development so our graduates are prepared for successful careers in academia, industry, and beyond. I invite you to explore our programs and discover the opportunities available in the Department of Chemistry. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Chemistry Education With Applied and Research Depth 01 The Department of Chemistry at Krishna School of Science, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), offers B.Sc. (Hons.) with Research in Chemistry, M.Sc. Organic Chemistry under NEP-2020, and Ph.D. programs in Chemistry. The department is equipped with modern laboratories and classroom infrastructure for robust teaching-learning experiences. 02 Faculty members bring diverse teaching and research backgrounds from leading national and international institutions. The department maintains MOUs with academic institutions and industries, creating strong opportunities for training, internships, and placements. 03 Industrial and institutional visits are regularly organized to deepen practical understanding. Students are encouraged to engage in research projects with formal reporting, which strengthens analytical thinking and problem-solving competencies. 04 Students are motivated to participate in workshops, seminars, conferences, and training sessions to stay connected with the latest advancements in chemistry. 05 Skill Enhanced Courses (SEC) bridge theory with practical competencies, while Value-Added Courses (VAC) and initiatives such as IPDC, IKS, NCC, NSS, social drives, and blood donation camps support holistic development and social responsibility. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision The Department of Chemistry endeavors to be perceived for excellence in Teaching – Learning adjunct by accrediting graduating students to strive in and confer to the developing exigency of the society. 01 Procure quality teaching-learning, research and service opportunities leading to holistic development of students through collusive exchange of ideas, unallied thought, and the highest ethical standards. 02 Serve high quality academic experiences through comprehensive & relevant curriculum at UG levels. 03 Foster research aptitude by extending infrastructural support and research guidance. 04 Inculcate the values of multi-disciplinary and inter-disciplinary approach and innovative thinking by promoting learning experiences in the field of chemical sciences and its allied fields. 05 Fruitage knowledgeable graduates for careers in academia, industry and GOs/NGOs. Promote an ethical and professional environment amongst faculties and students of the department. 06 Promote an ethical and professional environment amongst faculties and students of the department.
